summary: Build ESG data governance, validation, workflow, and assurance-readiness skills. Explore the practical five-day course and review the syllabus.
lede: ESG reporting data management helps sustainability, finance, audit, and IT professionals organize reliable information for disclosures. The course covers assigning data owners, documenting data lineage, checking emissions and social metrics, and building validation controls and reporting workflows with practical templates and Excel-based checks. Participants also practise assembling assurance evidence and defining reporting software requirements using IFRS S1 and S2, GRI Standards, and the GHG Protocol.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for collecting, controlling, analysing, or assuring sustainability information used in corporate and institutional reporting. This course is designed for: Sustainability Managers who coordinate disclosures and assign ESG data ownership. ESG Reporting Analysts who reconcile emissions and social performance metrics. Finance Controllers who validate sustainability figures for reporting packages. Internal Auditors who test ESG controls and retain assurance evidence. IT and Data Managers who map sustainability sources into reporting workflows. Carbon Accounting Specialists who document GHG Protocol calculations and assumptions. ESG Data Stewards who maintain definitions, lineage, and change records. Sustainability Assurance Practitioners who assess evidence against ISSA 5000 expectations. Financial Institution ESG Specialists who coordinate portfolio and operational metrics. NGO Reporting Leads who compile traceable programme and workforce indicators.
modules: IFRS S1, S2 and GRI Reporting Context
ESG Reporting Dashboard and Action Plan
prerequisites: Working familiarity with sustainability reporting, finance controls, audit, data management, or ESG metrics is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel for spreadsheet-based exercises; Power BI exposure is helpful but not required.
